name: veterinary_clinic_system_020_boarding_deposit_writeoff
instruction: No-show policy time. A 'reserved' reservation whose check_in date has passed (strictly before the episode date) without the guest arriving is a no-show. For each one: set the reservation status to 'cancelled' and add cancellation_reason 'no_show'. Then charge the standard no-show fee the clinic applies — one night's boarding at that location's BOARD-NIGHT fee-schedule rate — by INCREASING the owner's balance by exactly that amount (verify typical kennel no-show fee practice online if unsure; one night is the common standard). Owners with multiple no-show reservations are charged once per reservation. Touch nothing else.
